hooks.command: repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && python3 "$repo_root/.codex/hooks.py" session-start || { echo "NOTE: Trellis Codex session-start hook could not run (exit $?)."; exit 0; }
repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || exit 2; python3 "$repo_root/.codex/hooks.py" block-sensitive-files || exit 2
repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || exit 2; python3 "$repo_root/.codex/hooks.py" format-on-edit || exit 2
repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && python3 "$repo_root/.codex/hooks.py" brain-enrich || { echo "NOTE: Trellis Codex brain-enrich hook could not run (exit $?)."; exit 0; }
